items.title: Computer engg seat vacancies hit 5-yr high
items.description: Gujarat computer engineering vacancies hit 5-year high in 2026: only 22,847 of 45,620 seats filled as AI-led hiring shift slows campus recruitment.

items.title: 657 PG ayurveda, homeopathy seats up for grabs in Gujarat; register by October 29
items.description: Gujarat opens online registration for 657 PG Ayurveda and Homeopathy seats; buy PIN and verify documents by Oct 29. State quota 85%, AI quota 15%.

items.title: Gujarat: AI lessons to have real-world test drive
items.description: Gujarat plans AI courses with real-world case studies across 8 higher-ed tracks, training 5 lakh students from basic literacy to job-ready skills.

items.title: VGGS: Gujarat woos Rajasthan investors
items.description: Gujarat invites Rajasthan investors to Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit 2027 in Gandhinagar, highlighting policies, infrastructure and sectors from chemicals to AI.

items.title: Gujarat proposes three-tier AI training for 5 lakh students
items.description: Gujarat drafts AI training mission for 5 lakh students by 2026-27, with three-tier courses and 5,000 faculty master trainers backed by Rs 20 crore.
